name: gptme-pdk-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is gptme, a terminal-first AI agent written in Python. The agent acts through tools: the model
writes fenced code blocks (or provider-native tool calls), and gptme dispatches each one to a registered tool that
runs shell commands, executes Python, reads, saves and patches files, drives tmux sessions, browses, controls the
computer, delegates to subagents and more. The tools are defined as `ToolSpec` objects and loaded and executed by
the tool framework in the `gptme.tools` package.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is gptme's tools package: gptme/tools/ (every tool module, the tool framework in gptme/tools/__init__.py and gptme/tools/base.py, and the autocompact/ and subagent/ subpackages), together with the tool documentation pages docs/tools.rst, docs/computer-use-warning.rst (included by docs/tools.rst), docs/custom_tool.rst, docs/howto/edit-files.md and the tool lessons under docs/lessons/tools/, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the in-package
docstrings, including their examples; in-package code comments are only supporting evidence, and when a comment
